--add-cpes-if-none.help: generate CPEs for packages with no CPE data

--append.help: path for existing fixture directory to append to (mutually exclusive with --output)

--broad-cpe-matching.help: allow for specific package CPE attributes to match with '*' values on the vulnerability

--by-cve.help: orient results by CVE instead of the original vulnerability ID when possible

--distro.help: distro to match against in the format: <distro>[-:@]<version>

--dry-run.help: show what would be regenerated without making changes

--ecosystem.help: ecosystem of the package to search within

--exclude.help: exclude paths from being scanned using a glob expression

--fail-on.help: set the return code to 2 if a vulnerability is found with a severity >= the given severity, options=[negligible low medium high critical]

--file.help: file to write the default report output to (default is STDOUT)

--fixed-state.help: only show vulnerabilities with the given fix state (fixed, not-fixed, unknown, wont-fix)

--fixture.help: path to a specific fixture to regenerate (optional)

--force.help: regenerate even if fixture has been modified

--from.help: specify the source behavior to use (e.g. docker, registry, podman, oci-dir, ...)

--ignore-states.help: ignore matches for vulnerabilities with specified comma separated fix states, options=[fixed not-fixed unknown wont-fix]

--limit.help: limit the number of results returned, use 0 for no limit

--modified-after.help: only show vulnerabilities originally published or modified since the given date (format: YYYY-MM-DD)

--name.help: set the name of the target being analyzed

--only-fixed.help: ignore matches for vulnerabilities that are not fixed

--only-notfixed.help: ignore matches for vulnerabilities that are fixed

--output.help: report output formatter, formats=[json table cyclonedx cyclonedx-json sarif template], deprecated formats=[embedded-cyclonedx-vex-json embedded-cyclonedx-vex-xml]

--platform.help: an optional platform specifier for container image sources (e.g. 'linux/arm64', 'linux/arm64/v8', 'arm64', 'linux')

--provider.help: only show vulnerabilities from the given provider

--published-after.help: only show vulnerabilities originally published after the given date (format: YYYY-MM-DD)

--pull.help: fetch the latest v1 schema from upstream and overwrite the pinned schema-v1.json before regenerating

--root.help: name to use for the top-level struct (defaults to the schema title if empty)

--scope.help: selection of layers to analyze, options=[squashed all-layers deep-squashed] (default "squashed")

--show-suppressed.help: show suppressed/ignored vulnerabilities in the output (only supported with table output format)

--sort-by.help: sort the match results with the given strategy, options=[package severity epss risk kev vulnerability] (default "risk")

--template.help: specify the path to a Go template file (requires 'template' output to be selected)

--vex.help: a list of VEX documents to consider when producing scanning results

--vuln.help: only show results for the given vulnerability ID

check.help: Check to see if there is a database update available

completion.help: Generate a shell completion for Grype (listing local docker images)

diff.help: Diff two databases, showing packages with added, removed, and modified vulnerability matches

explain.help: Ask grype to explain a set of findings

import.help: Import a vulnerability database or archive from a local file or URL

list.help: List all DBs available according to the listing URL

providers.help: List vulnerability providers that are in the database

search.help: Search the DB for vulnerabilities or affected packages

update.help: Download and install the latest vulnerability database

vuln.help: Search for vulnerabilities within the DB (supports DB schema v6+ only)
